- Add rows in the same PR that deletes the code; never relax an existing row without an ADR amendment.
- allowedPaths are matched as path prefixes (POSIX). Trailing slash means directory.
asserts that injecting any banned identifier into a fixture causes the guard to fail.
Update the self-test sample map when adding patterns whose regex source isn't already listed.

patterns._followUp: The UMR is the bound binder's Unique Market Reference (canonical owner: Binder.umr, resolved via resolvePolicyUmrFromBinder). The `generateUMR` fabricator and its `policyNumberGenerator` module were deleted — a policy's UMR must never be derived from the policy/quote number or generated. Regenerate docs/architecture/backend-dependency-graph.svg via `npm run docs:generate` to clear the stale edge.

Runtime module-level reads in emailInfra.ts and platformIds.ts were removed; remaining executable reads are limited to HTTP slug resolution, its tests, the deleted-identifiers self-test fixture, and one migration script that requires an explicit tenant slug.
PR 1B deleted the env-flag and the synthetic-result branch in binderAuthority.ts. Production K8s manifests must drop this var as part of the rollout.
Permission checks fail closed unconditionally. The retired env flag must not reappear in runtime code.

PR 2 separated quote-token signing onto its own QUOTE_TOKEN_SECRET keyspace. The OR-fallback chain between the two secrets is the specific deleted pattern; JWT_SECRET still legitimately serves the session / FNOL / OTP layers in their own modules.

PR 4 closed ADR-0016: the canonical EV capacity field is `batteryKWh`. The legacy ADR-0012 sentinel flag has been deleted from the QuoteData type, the normalizer, and the UW automation. Legacy stored EV records (engineSize=1, no batteryKWh) are flagged on rerate via YELLOW.EV_BATTERY_KWH_MISSING.

PR 5 closed ADR-0014: home rate cards live as JSON + zod + loader at `backend/products/home/pricing/data/`. The deprecated `homeRateCards.ts` re-export shim has been deleted; consumers import from `data/loader.js` directly. The pure-re-export-shim exemption in `check-no-inline-rate-tables.mjs` was also removed.

New claim payment writes use PAYMENT_ADDED with canonical classification. Historical event names may appear only in read-only projection/KPI code and tests. The `worksheetProjection/` submodule directory was added in the errors-and-warnings cleanup sprint when the parent file was split — same role, same allowance.
